failure_summary.description: Agents omitted saving search results or bypassed compatible cached results instead of retrieving and filtering them.
Agents mapped state abbreviations to city and normalized an attraction type instead of preserving the user's exact value.
An incomplete hotel search was attempted with missing dates rather than seeking the required information while handling the independent attraction request.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly covers each observed error: saving every tool result, retrieving and filtering compatible cached results, preserving state and category values exactly, and seeking missing mandatory inputs while continuing independent requests. These trajectories show noncompliance with existing guidance rather than a missing skill rule, so no edits are warranted.
